objective: Replace the verbose multi-line /swe list cards with a compact, scan-friendly initiative overview that avoids terminal wrapping.
constraints: Keep focus, status, revision, progress, and current/next work visible.
Fit every rendered line within a conservative 78-column width.
Do not repeat objectives for every initiative.
Preserve the 25-initiative display bound and existing focus behavior.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Bare /swe list renders one compact primary row per initiative with aligned status, progress, revision, and identifier columns.
Only initiatives with current or next work receive a concise indented work-detail row; terminal initiatives remain one line.
Every rendered line is at most 78 visible columns and regression tests cover compact and focused output.

assessment.reason: Contained presentation correction following direct usability feedback.

practices.reason: Formatting must remain compact, bounded, and preserve focus semantics.
Review scanability, width bounds, and compatibility after implementation.

obligations.text: Run type checking and targeted pi-swe runtime/docket tests.
Review the final rendering implementation and tests for usability and regressions.

work.title: Implement compact initiative list rows and regression coverage

testing.approach: Assert exact compact row structure, omission of objectives, focus marker, conditional work rows, and maximum visible width.
testing.reason: Directly guards the reported formatting failure.

args: npm run typecheck && node --experimental-strip-types --test test/pi-swe-runtime.test.ts test/pi-swe-docket.test.ts

evidence.summary: Model self-review (not independent or human review): reviewed the compact table renderer and regression changes. Each initiative now has one aligned primary row; only current/next work adds a detail row; objectives and repeated blank card spacing are removed. Visible-width clipping is capped at 78 columns, focus and ranking semantics are unchanged, the 25-item bound remains, and tests cover actionable, focused, and terminal output. No blocking findings.

decisions.text: Use one aligned primary row per initiative and a conditional indented current/next work row.
decisions.basis: Optimizes for scanning while retaining actionable context.

risks.text: Long identifiers or work titles may wrap in narrow terminals.
risks.mitigation: Render to a conservative 78-column visible-width bound with explicit truncation.
